name: trimcarbon
description: CO₂ estimates for general-aviation flying: by aircraft and hours, by fleet, or by fuel burned.

interface.longDescription: Ask about the CO₂ of your flying and TrimCarbon works it out from its figures for about 60 general-aviation aircraft types, from trainers and touring aircraft to twins and helicopters. It handles one pilot, a whole flight school or club fleet, or an amount of fuel (avgas 100LL, mogas or Jet A). The result shows in a card where you can change the hours or the fuel, and each figure links to the page that explains it. The figures count the CO₂ from burning fuel only. No account is needed.
defaultPrompt: What's the CO₂ of 50 hours a year in a Cessna 172?
Our school flies 600 h in 172s and 120 h in a Seminole. Our CO₂?
How much CO₂ does burning 100 gallons of avgas release?

positive.description: One pilot, one aircraft type, hours per year
positive.prompt: What's the CO₂ of 50 hours a year in a Cessna 172?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls estimate_flight_hours with a C172 row of 50 hours per year. Answers about 4,400 kg of CO₂ per year (4.4 t) and shows the card with editable hours.

positive.description: A flight school fleet with two types
positive.prompt: Our flight school flies 600 hours a year in Cessna 172s and 120 hours in a Piper Seminole. What's our CO₂?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls estimate_flight_hours with two rows (C172 600 h, PA-44 Seminole 120 h). Answers about 76,080 kg of CO₂ per year, with the figure for each type.

positive.prompt: How much CO₂ comes from burning 100 US gallons of avgas?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls estimate_fuel_burn with avgas-100ll, 100, usGal. Answers about 831 kg of CO₂ and shows the card.

positive.description: CO₂ per hour of one type
positive.prompt: How much CO₂ per flight hour does a Cirrus SR22 emit?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_aircraft for SR22. Answers 136 kg of CO₂ per flight hour and links to the aircraft's page on trimcarbon.com.

positive.prompt: Can you work out my CO₂ from my ForeFlight logbook export?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls import_logbook. The card asks for the file and reads it on the device. After the user shares the totals, answers with the CO₂ of the last 12 months and by aircraft type.

negative.prompt: What's the CO₂ of driving my car from Boston to New York?
Book me a flight from Toronto to Paris next Friday.
What's the weather at KPAO this afternoon?

review.commerce_description: No purchases. The plugin sells nothing, and its links go only to trimcarbon.com pages that explain its figures.

publication.release_notes: First release in ChatGPT. CO₂ estimates for general-aviation flying: from flight hours in one aircraft type or a whole fleet, or from fuel burned (avgas 100LL, mogas or Jet A), in a card where you can change the hours. Reads a ForeFlight, Garmin Pilot or LogTen logbook export on your device, without uploading it. With a connected TrimCarbon account, shows your own CO₂ impact, orders and certificates, read-only.

fr-FR.subtitle: Estimations du CO₂ des vols
fr-FR.description: Demandez le CO₂ de vos vols : TrimCarbon le calcule à partir de ses chiffres pour une soixantaine de types d’avions de l’aviation générale, des avions école aux bimoteurs et hélicoptères. Il traite un pilote, toute la flotte d’une école ou d’un aéroclub, ou une quantité de carburant (avgas 100LL, mogas ou Jet A). Le résultat s’affiche dans une carte où vous pouvez modifier les heures ou le carburant, et chaque chiffre renvoie à la page qui l’explique. Les chiffres comptent le CO₂ issu de la combustion du carburant uniquement. Aucun compte requis.

de-DE.subtitle: CO₂-Schätzungen für Flüge
de-DE.description: Fragen Sie nach dem CO₂ Ihrer Flüge: TrimCarbon berechnet es aus seinen Zahlen für rund 60 Flugzeugmuster der allgemeinen Luftfahrt, vom Schulflugzeug bis zu zweimotorigen Flugzeugen und Hubschraubern. Es rechnet für einen Piloten, die ganze Flotte einer Flugschule oder eines Vereins oder für eine Treibstoffmenge (Avgas 100LL, Mogas oder Jet A). Das Ergebnis erscheint in einer Karte, in der Sie Stunden oder Treibstoff ändern können, und jede Zahl verweist auf die Seite, die sie erklärt. Die Zahlen erfassen nur das CO₂ aus der Verbrennung des Treibstoffs. Kein Konto nötig.

pt-BR.subtitle: Estimativas de CO₂ de voos
pt-BR.description: Pergunte o CO₂ dos seus voos: a TrimCarbon o calcula com os seus números para cerca de 60 tipos de aeronave da aviação geral, de aeronaves de instrução a bimotores e helicópteros. Ela atende um piloto, a frota inteira de uma escola ou aeroclube, ou uma quantidade de combustível (avgas 100LL, mogas ou Jet A). O resultado aparece em um cartão onde você pode alterar as horas ou o combustível, e cada número leva à página que o explica. Os números contam apenas o CO₂ da queima do combustível. Não é preciso ter conta.

es-419.subtitle: Estimaciones de CO₂ de vuelos
es-419.description: Pregunte por el CO₂ de sus vuelos: TrimCarbon lo calcula con sus cifras para unos 60 tipos de aeronave de la aviación general, desde aviones de instrucción hasta bimotores y helicópteros. Atiende a un piloto, a toda la flota de una escuela o aeroclub, o a una cantidad de combustible (avgas 100LL, mogas o Jet A). El resultado aparece en una tarjeta donde puede cambiar las horas o el combustible, y cada cifra enlaza con la página que la explica. Las cifras cuentan solo el CO₂ de la quema del combustible. No necesita una cuenta.

it-IT.subtitle: Stime della CO₂ dei voli
it-IT.description: Chieda la CO₂ dei suoi voli: TrimCarbon la calcola con i suoi dati per circa 60 tipi di aeromobile dell’aviazione generale, dagli aerei scuola ai bimotori e agli elicotteri. Gestisce un pilota, l’intera flotta di una scuola o di un aeroclub, o una quantità di carburante (avgas 100LL, mogas o Jet A). Il risultato appare in una scheda dove può cambiare le ore o il carburante, e ogni dato rimanda alla pagina che lo spiega. I dati contano solo la CO₂ dalla combustione del carburante. Nessun account necessario.
